mapper.sql: menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, menu_sort, menu_type, path, component, route_name, visible, status, icon, is_frame, permission, remark, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, is_deleted, delete_time
mapper.select: SELECT m.permission FROM t_sys_menu as m INNER JOIN t_sys_role_menu AS rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role AS ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND rm.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.visible = 1 AND m.menu_type = 3

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id FROM t_sys_menu m INNER JOIN t_sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN (1, 2) -- 只查询目录和菜单 AND m.visible = 1 -- 菜单显示 AND m.status = 1 -- 菜单状态正常 AND m.is_deleted = 0 -- 菜单未删除 AND rm.is_deleted = 0 -- 角色菜单关联未删除 AND ur.is_deleted = 0 -- 用户角色关联未删除 AND m.parent_id = '0' -- 查询顶级菜单 ORDER BY m.menu_sort ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id FROM t_sys_menu m INNER JOIN t_sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type = 2 -- 只查询菜单 AND m.visible = 1 -- 菜单显示 AND m.status = 1 -- 菜单状态正常 AND m.is_deleted = 0 -- 菜单未删除 AND rm.is_deleted = 0 -- 角色菜单关联未删除 AND ur.is_deleted = 0 -- 用户角色关联未删除 AND m.parent_id = #{parentId} -- 查询顶级菜单 ORDER BY m.menu_sort ASC
